_about: Made-up symptom descriptions for checking AI-pinion. 'accept' lists the names that count as a correct answer for the case (the first is the name to search PubMed with). Add real cases only with the person's agreement, and never commit personal details. Overlapping cases are included on purpose: they test whether the three possibilities cover the likely options.
